verdict.rationale: Docs show Computer takes on complex, multi-step work autonomously. It searches and browses the web in real time, runs browser tasks across dozens of URLs in parallel, collects results into structured output, and can produce documents such as PDFs, which covers the autonomous many-source research half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows that outputs carry source citations or that there is a dedicated deep-research report mode, and there is no hands-on confirmation of report quality. Missing for 10: evidence of cited/sourced reports, a documented deep-research workflow, independent hands-on corroboration.
